premises.text: Large pre-consumer food waste and rising protein shortage are twin problems a conversion process can address together
premises.evidence_span: 1.4 billion tons of food is wasted every year, 40% before it's touched human hands

premises.text: A hatchery-to-incubator insect process converts food waste into edible-insect protein powder and fertilizer
premises.evidence_span: Natransa produces the next generation protein from a specific edible insect by converting food waste into fertilizer

premises.text: Companies pay to dispose of food waste while the venture also sells protein powder and fertilizer
premises.evidence_span: Companies pay us to get rid of their food waste. So we get revenue by taking our raw material and by selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer

premises.text: The production system uses minimal water and land, zero grain, and near-zero carbon emissions versus other protein sources
premises.evidence_span: It needs minimal water and land, requires zero grain, and almost produces zero carbon emission

premises.text: The insect protein powder has higher protein, calcium, and phosphorus than regular meat
premises.evidence_span: Our product has two times more protein, 100 times more calcium, and four times more phosphorus than regular meat

premises.text: Initial go-to-market is pet protein via influencers and pet-shop B2B partners
premises.evidence_span: To grow our B2C customers, we work with influencers and we also have pet shops as our B2B partners

premises.text: Human alternative-protein path targets athletes, renal/cancer patients, and people allergic to regular meat
premises.evidence_span: We first target three initial customer segments. One is athletes who already use whey protein additional to their diet. And there are renal and cancer patients

premises.text: Competing alternatives (plant-based, artificial meat, crickets) are costlier, less nutritious, or not scalable
premises.evidence_span: There are other alternatives, but they are cost prohibitively expensive to compare with regular meat

domains.name: Insect conversion process and product performance

value.text: Sustainable next-generation protein from food-waste-fed edible insects
value.evidence_span: we can convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems

secondary_value.text: Healthier, more sustainable protein for humans as long-term vision
secondary_value.evidence_span: producing much healthier and more sustainable protein sources for humans
